mechanism.whyThisOne: (1) it is judged on historical PRs whose change-sets are reconstructible offline from the local git object store (no egress, no local-model runs), giving n≈400 rows instead of the 4 tasks × 2 trials of the V159 routing evidence; (2) its effect on outcomes was never measured (#902 'gain not measured'); (3) V157_PERFORMANCE_BASELINE.inspectionFixes902 records that after the #902 fixes ALL five measured historical PRs select L3 REINFORCED — the selector is over-inclusive by design, so as an ordering of verification need it barely discriminates; the scenario-G lesson (measured LOCAL calibration from ODG's own data) applies: calibrate an ordering on ODG's own history without lowering any control
mechanism.improvement: H1 = odg-verification-risk-calibration (new pure module COMPOSING chooseLevel — no second selector/graph/parser): an ADDITIVE advisory verification-risk score over the plan; it never changes level/reinforced/independentInspection/mandatoryPreMergeCI/tests. features(plan, changedFiles) = [f1 levelRank (DOCS_ONLY 0, L1 1, L2 2, L3 3), f2 reinforced (0/1), f3 number of DISTINCT sensitive-category labels over plan.files[].sensitive, f4 log1p(#changedFiles), f5 log1p(#plan.tests.L2), f6 log1p(plan.graph.reverseClosure), f7 log1p(#plan.unresolved), f8 (#plan.files with class DOC)/(#plan.files, 0 if none)]. Fit on DEV ONLY: each feature standardized with DEV mean and population sd (sd = 0 ⇒ feature weight fixed at 0); L2-regularized logistic regression of HIGH_ITERATION, loss = mean log-loss + (λ/(2·n_dev))·‖w‖² with λ = 1 (intercept not penalized), batch gradient descent from all-zero weights, learning rate 0.1, 5000 iterations (deterministic, no randomness). score = intercept + w·standardized features. Additions/deletions (the G size feature) are deliberately NOT features.
mechanism.adoptionScope: a PASS makes H1 an ADOPTION CANDIDATE only (advisory verification-risk score); wiring it into chooseLevel's output or any gate is OUT of H's scope and needs a separate decision

preRegistration.metric: ROC AUC (Mann–Whitney U / (n_pos·n_neg), ties count 0.5) of each score vs HIGH_ITERATION on the HELDOUT split; Δ0 = AUC(H1) − AUC(B0); Δ1 = AUC(H1) − AUC(B1); n, n_pos, n_neg reported

preRegistration.minimumN: HELDOUT ≥ 20 HIGH_ITERATION and ≥ 20 LOW_ITERATION rows; DEV ≥ 10 of each (fit needs both classes)

thresholds.NOT_MEASURED: dataset sha256 ≠ the pinned value, OR minimumN not met, OR chooseLevel throws on any row (no silent drop), OR the fit yields a non-finite weight, OR > 5% of bootstrap resamples skipped

thresholds.PARTIAL: Δ0 > 0 but the PASS conditions are not all met — in particular Δ1 ≤ 0 (or CI95 lower bound of Δ1 ≤ 0) with Δ0 > 0 is PARTIAL, never PASS
